title: ACT Beauty designs the toiletry bag for the launch of Ollie
summary: ACT Beauty has designed and manufactured the toiletry bag for the launch of Ollie, a French skincare brand targeting teenagers and created to address an identified gap in the market. Finished with a soft-touch, puffer-style quilted treatment, the toiletry bag features a functional design built around a main compartment secured with a chunky zip closure, carry handles, and two additional flat pockets at the front.
